import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        p_str, k_str = line.split()
        p = int(p_str)
        k = int(k_str)
        if k == 0:
            l = p - 1
        elif k == 1:
            l = p
        else:
            t = 1
            v = k
            while v != 1:
                v = (v * k) % p
                t += 1
            l = p // t
        ans = 1
        for _ in range(l):
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
